posts.t:
EUR-JPY -

Does anyone have insights in to why this trade failed?

I entered a long position (as shown in post # 603) and price bounced nicely. I was up over 40 pips, and price was approaching my limit, when price tanked. The reason I took the trade was due to the engulf and nice RT to the DP (also a S/R flip area). It seems like a pretty good place to go long....I wonder what happened. I didn't see any high impact news during this time, and price doesn't usually move so much during the Asian session. I am really confused on this.

(you can ignore the current entry/stop as I took the trade again on a demo account)

Here is a 4-HR chart - the place I had my target was the DP for price to engulf # 2. I was going to get short after closing out my long.
posts.fa:

کسی بینش یا توضیحی دارد که چرا این معامله شکست خورد؟

پوزیشن خرید گرفتم (همان‌طور که در پست # 603 نشان داده شد) و قیمت خوب برگشت. بیش از 40 پیپ در سود بودم و قیمت در حال نزدیک‌شدن به تارگتم بود که سقوط کرد. دلیل گرفتن معامله اینگالف و RT خوب به DP بود (که ناحیهٔ Flip مربوط به S/R هم بود). به‌نظر مکان نسبتاً خوبی برای خرید بود… نمی‌دانم چه اتفاقی افتاد. در این بازه خبر مهمی ندیدم و قیمت معمولاً در سشن آسیا این‌قدر حرکت نمی‌کند. واقعاً در این موضوع گیج شدم.

چارت 4 ساعته را ببینید - جایی که تارگتم را گذاشته بودم، DP برای اینگالف قیمت # 2 بود. قرار بود بعد از بستن لانگ، فروش بگیرم.

posts.t:
(Continued from last post)

First, I am zooming out to look at the bigger picture to see if price was entering an obvious Demand/FTR/FL etc... from above. I typically start on higher time frame charts to ID opportunities before dropping down to lower time frames. Here is what I wold have seen on Salivan's trade:

What I see:

1. Price initially enters a zone where I would definitely expect a bounce. Price enters a strong demand zone (fresh) which also served as the origin of the previous move up. There is also a QM level in this demand zone (as I show on the chart).. If you look closely however, Salivan takes the trade on price's second return (deeper) in to this demand zone. I wouldn't have been looking for buys after price initially broke in and broke out of the demand zone. I probably would have switched to a different chart if I had been watching live, thinking the best bounce was the bounce that occurred on price's FTB.

Let's zoom in and see what else is showing....
posts.fa:
